instruction: Repair src/v012_inventory.py so tests/v012_verify.py passes. parse_inventory must accept an iterable of text lines. Ignore blank lines and lines whose first non-whitespace character is #. Every other line must contain exactly one colon separating item name and quantity. Normalize item names by stripping leading/trailing whitespace, converting to lowercase, and collapsing every run of internal whitespace to one ASCII space. Item names must not be empty. Quantities must be base-10 integers greater than zero. Aggregate duplicate normalized item names by summing their quantities. Invalid non-comment input must raise ValueError. Return only the complete corrected Python source file.
